To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) financial incentives to physicians did not improve hypertension control in the short term, (2) financial incentives to practice teams did improve hypertension control in patients in the short term and (3) financial incentives to both physicians and teams had no long-term impact.

the extent to which the measurement of blood pressures in the clinic is susceptible to manipulation.
